scope: Device Control workflow rerun after desktop bottom-navigation interception fix

phases.name: workflow
phases.assertion: The session-kill journey now passes after hiding the fixed bottom navigation at the desktop breakpoint. Remaining failures are onboarding-empty-state because this host exposes available transports, and run-review-evidence because no screenshot-capable target can produce a retained image.

fixesValidated: Desktop viewport no longer has a fixed mobile bottom navigation intercepting dashboard lease controls.
Dashboard initial and background inventory requests use the non-blocking cached snapshot.
supportingChecks: Device Control UI focused shell/workflow tests: 16 passed
Device Control UI: pnpm type-check passed
Device Control UI: pnpm build passed
Device Control API: go test ./... passed
limitations: The onboarding case requires an actually detached Android device or isolated empty-inventory fixture.
The run-review case requires a screenshot-capable device target; no such target is attached on this host.
Live Windows, macOS arm64, GNOME Wayland, and KDE Wayland acceptance remains unavailable.
